item.title: Veteran Congress Leader and Former Union Minister Biren Singh Engti Passes Away in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: Veteran Congress leader and former Union Minister Biren Singh Engti passed away on Tuesday, March 10, morning , marking the end of an era in Assam’s hill politics. He breathed his last at around 7:45 AM at hospital in Guwahati, where he had been undergoing treatment.
